goal: Operational planning study on this grid model: bring the Landesbergen-Wehrendorf line current below the 1,795 A warning value at Wehrendorf, while keeping the single-outage screen free of overloads. Propose switching or generator redispatch actions, do not change protection settings or ratings, verify each action in the grid model, and recommend the order to apply them.
label: post-hoc engineering run
